Croaking pond leaper whose kick the breaststroker borrows
Harald, the Norwegian king cut down at Stamford Bridge on 25 September
Professional warrior of the English royal bodyguard, axe over his shoulder
Rod-and-line devotee — or the deep-sea fish that hunts with a glowing stalk
Double overarm style an Englishman brought home from South America
Viral lump under the foot, picked up on damp communal tiles
Made-up terminal tackle: line, lead and the sharp end, running or hair
